subject.title: chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 4.3.0 to 5.2.1 in the npm group

question: Should this PR intentionally reverse current main's recent `js-yaml` 4.2.0 alignment with Astro and adopt 5.2.1?
rationale: Repository history establishes a deliberate v5-to-v4 alignment immediately before this PR, but does not establish whether 5.2.1 resolves the underlying compatibility constraint.

options.title: Preserve the v4 alignment
options.body: Close or defer this automated bump until the reason for aligning `js-yaml` with Astro is confirmed obsolete.

options.title: Approve a fully validated v5 upgrade
options.body: Confirm the direction, synchronize `bun.lock`, and require clean-install, runtime, build, built-asset, and Vercel deployment proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve the v4 alignment
recommendation.body: Close or defer this automated bump until the reason for aligning `js-yaml` with Astro is confirmed obsolete.
